lines.say: Mega Man 3 added a dog, a slide, and a brother. And its own artist still calls it his least favorite.
It came out in Japan in September 1990, and in America that November.
The big new move was the slide, letting you zip under low walls and enemy fire.
It also introduced Rush, a robot dog who turns into a spring, a jet, and a submarine.
And a mysterious whistling rival, called Break Man, keeps showing up to fight you.
He's really Proto Man, Mega Man's older brother.
After the eight robot masters, you face Doc Robot, who copies all eight bosses from Mega Man 2.
But development was rough. The lead planner left partway through, and Keiji Inafune had to take over.
Capcom wanted it out in September instead of December, so the team ran out of time to polish it.
Inafune later said it's his least favorite, because he knew it could have been better.

args.text: WE COULD DO A LOT OF THINGS BETTER

lines.say: Proof it was rushed? Debug cheats were left in. Hold right on the second controller, and Mega Man jumps sky high.
Hold up on that controller, and the whole game runs in slow motion.
It still sold over a million copies.
